tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i zhus lan zin bris bzhugs// rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i drung du/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i sngags pa zhig dri ba zhus pa'i lan gnang byung ba la chos rje kun blos zin bris su bkod pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ nged kyi chos rje sa bzang 'phags pas cis kyang nyon gsungs nas/ ngas kyang rgyud gsang snying sogs dang / khro bo dam pa rgyan/ zhi ba rin chen dra ba la sogs gzhung du ma nyan/ zhi ba 'di gsang snying dang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud la brten par 'dug khro bo 'di gsang snying dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor la rten par 'dug cing / gzhung 'di gnyis grub chen sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad nges par snang / zhi ba rdo rje las rim dang / khro bo rdo rje las rim gnyis kyang gzhung khyad du 'phags par 'dug rnying po oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha dzña na dha tu a/ zhes pa 'di sngags don bzang po rang cig snang ste/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ bo dhi tsit+ta byang chub kyi sems/ ma hā su kha bde ba chen po/ dzña na dha tu dbyings dang ye shes te/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po zhes 'bod cing / bdag la yang de ltar rtogs pa bskyed cig pa/ a sa bon yin tshod du 'dug /ru lu bsgyur rgyu med/ gzungs kyi tshig zhes bya ba yin te/ bde mchog pa'i nye snying lta bu'o/ ru lu 'di mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud nas mang du gsungs/ badz+ra kī li ki la ya rdo rje phur pa phur pa zhes 'bod cing bskul/ bos nas ci byed na/ sarba bigh+nan baṃ bgegs thams cad chings shig hūm̐ sa bon/ phaṭ khos cig pa yin/ spyir da lta gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum nas 'byung ba'i rgyud gsang 'dus sogs sngar 'gyur gyi dus su byung ba'i rgyud rnams dag la rnying ma ba'i brda chad la/ sku'i rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ gsung gi rgyud zla bzang thig le/ thugs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/

yon tan gyi rgyud rdo rje bdud rtsi/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud ka ma la/ kha skong gi rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams rgyud khyad du 'phags pa 'dug karma ma la nga yis ma mthong / sngon dus khyad 'phags cig byung bar snang / yang dag 'di yang mnyam nyid sbyor la brten pa'i man ngag khyad 'phags a tshi ba yin par 'dug me dgu ma mnyam sbyor gyi he ru ka rigs rkyang lha dgu ma dang gcig tu 'dug dpyal pa 'di pas yang dag dang kye rdor lha grangs/ lha'i ming 'dra ba dgu ste/ zhen pho rus de gnyis la byed/ spyir rnying ma ba tsho chang cig 'tshos/ yul dro na khru klog /grang na rgyud rtsoms zer bas lhad che/ de'i nang nas kyang rta mgrin gyi skor 'di lhad che/ gsar ma ba la phyag na rdo rje'i skor lhad che bar snang / 'on kyang khyod rang sa skya pa dang byas pa'i sngon gyi gsar ma ba chen po'i rjes su 'brang pa ma yin pa'i deng sang ci yin 'di yin med pa'i gsar ma ba mang po gcig yod/ de rnams las rnying ma tsho ched kyi khyad 'phags/ bstan pa 'jig kha rang du khong rnams rgyun ring zhing phan par 'ong gsungs/ zhes chos rje kun blos zin bris su bkod pa'i dpe rnying las sa skya pa kun dga'i ming can gyis shin tu dag par zhus dag bgyis te bkod pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i zhus lan zin bris/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
